Name: Em's crops artisan goods forage Items trash and more
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
An Em's version of the ’Spring objects’ tilesheet, including several [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] items[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Trash]
[/url]See the following parts for more notes on configuration options

﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/NG2Xzc8r/Config-Items.png[/img]

You can disable categories of items in the [i]config.json[/i]
Here you can also change the drinks to be in a mug or a glass

To disable an item category:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the Em's mod folder
Replace the "[color=#e69138]true[/color]" with "[color=#e69138]false[/color]" 
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!

To change a drink from a mug to a glass:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the Em's mod folder
Replace the "[color=#e69138]Mug[/color]" with "[color=#e69138]Glass[/color]"
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Items"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/G3TD5CPy/Planned-Items.png[/img]

Eventually, I would like to remake each item. But because that's a pretty big task, I'm taking it in parts
Each update will include more items, such as fish, stones, debris, and monster loot!
